front: When was the Bay of Pigs invasion?
back: 17 April 1961; about 1,400 CIA-trained Cuban exiles were defeated within three days.

front: When were the missile sites photographed?
back: 14 October 1962, by a U-2 spy plane.

front: Why did Khrushchev put missiles in Cuba?
back: To protect Cuba, close the missile gap, answer US missiles in Turkey, gain a bargaining chip and show strength.
28 October 1962: missiles removed in return for a US no-invasion pledge and a secret promise to remove Jupiter missiles from Turkey.

front: Name two results of the crisis in 1963.
back: The Moscow-Washington hotline and the Partial Test Ban Treaty (August 1963).
27 October 1962: Khrushchev's second letter arrived and a U-2 was shot down over Cuba.
